title: TrajectoryResponse
description: Response schema for GET /api/vehicles/{plate}/trajectory - Chronological cross-camera trajectory reconstruction

plate_number.description: Target vehicle license plate registration number, e.g. GJ01AB1234

total_sightings.description: Total number of verified historical sightings for this plate

first_seen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of earliest sighting in Gujarat camera network

last_seen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of most recent sighting in Gujarat camera network

sightings.description: Chronological array of individual vehicle sighting events across cameras

camera_id.description: Camera asset ID where vehicle was captured

department.description: Camera owning department (Police, RTO, GSRTC, etc.)

pts_timestamp_ms.description: Hardware presentation timestamp in milliseconds from video stream

direction_of_travel.description: Estimated vehicle heading vector from Kalman tracking

snapshot_url.description: Storage URL of plate / vehicle crop image

snapshot_hash_sha256.description: SHA-256 cryptographic hash of snapshot for NFSU chain of custody

watchlist_status.description: Federated watchlist status aggregated across VAHAN, eGujCop, SARTHI, AFIS, NAFIS

is_watchlisted.description: True if vehicle or owner is flagged in any surveillance or criminal registry

threat_level.description: Highest threat rating assigned to vehicle

matched_databases.description: List of databases containing matches (e.g. VAHAN, eGujCop, NAFIS)

associated_firs.description: Array of linked First Information Report (FIR) numbers
